name: ANSI/IEEE Three-phase T winding connection form
summary: IEEE-library form of three-phase t winding connection: a T winding qualifier identifies the publisher's three-phase T connection form.
description: This reference locates three-phase t winding connection in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented winding family. A T winding qualifier identifies the publisher's three-phase T connection form. The public library uses Q060204 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.
